names: Mission Bay Education Center and Dental Clinics
summary: Two buildings tracked as one record, their mapped footprints sharing DataSF Building Footprints id SF3940003: 499 Illinois Street (the southern footprint), a 6-story biotechnology building (its structural engineer describes a 500,000 sq ft center in two buildings) completed 2008 and owned by Alexandria (SF Standard: "long-time landlord Alexandria Properties") until UCSF bought it; and 409 Illinois Street (the northern footprint), which SF Standard says was bought from the same landlord together with 499 Illinois St for $767,000,000 (closing on December 17, 2025) and which UCSF plans to renovate into a new School of Dentistry and a shared education center for students in dentistry, medicine, nursing, pharmacy and physical therapy (the university's project title is Mission Bay Education Center and Dental Clinics). UC filed a Notice of Exemption on May 7, 2026 for an "Advanced Work Phase" of site preparation, and American School & University (September 8, 2026) says "Early construction activities are underway". That magazine reports a completion date targeted for late 2029; SF Standard reports the building is expected to be ready for occupants in the first quarter of 2029. The City's 2006 building permit #200607186938 lists both 409 and 499 Illinois St and shows status "complete" with a completed date of 2009-04-06 (a permit closure date; the permit does not say what stands at 409 today). SF Standard says 409 "will get a 'gut remodel,'" while "only minor work is needed at the other building"; no source read dates the start of the main renovation. The record's status, complete, rests on the 2008 completion of 499 and the 2009 permit closure for both addresses; the 409 renovation is not complete, and the "under construction" milestone below is an expected one that rests on the early work only. UCSF's Valley Center for Vision at 490 Illinois St is a separate record, across Illinois St.

milestones.text: SF Dept. of Building Inspection permit #200607186938 filed to erect the 6-story medical research and biotechnical research facility at 499 Illinois St

The University of California (named as buyer in its own CEQA notice; SF Standard says UCSF) buys 409 Illinois St and 499 Illinois St together from "long-time landlord Alexandria Properties" (SF Standard) for $767,000,000; SF Standard says the school "closed on Dec. 17": approximately 525,421 rentable sq ft on 3.6 acres with a 587-space shared garage. UC's own CEQA Notice of Exemption for the acquisition (Class 1, Existing Facilities) was posted the next day.

UC files a separate CEQA Notice of Exemption for an "Advanced Work Phase" at 409/499 Illinois St -- site preparation and make-ready construction elements ahead of the main renovation, also a Class 1 exemption.

Early construction work is under way and the main renovation of 409 Illinois St is expected to begin in 2026: 261,117 gross sq ft to be converted into a new home for UCSF's School of Dentistry and a shared education center for students in dentistry, medicine, nursing, pharmacy and physical therapy (UC's project title: Mission Bay Education Center and Dental Clinics). American School & University (2026-09-08) says "renovation work expected to begin in 2026" and "Early construction activities are underway" while final design is completed; Suffolk (contractor) and CO Architects (architect) were selected via progressive design-build (Construction Dive, published September 1, 2026, citing an August 27 announcement). No source read dates the start of the main renovation. This milestone is expected, not confirmed, and is for 409 Illinois St only: the record's status (complete) rests on the 2008 completion of 499 and the 2009 permit closure, not on this renovation.

Completion of the new School of Dentistry and education center at 409 Illinois St is expected in 2029. American School & University magazine (2026-09-08) reports a completion date targeted for late 2029; SF Standard (2025-12-17) instead reports that construction is expected to take about three years and the building to be ready for occupants in the first quarter of 2029

details.text: Owner of 499 Illinois St: Alexandria's 2013 release calls it 'Alexandria's 499 Illinois Street'; SF Standard reports its sale to UC in December 2025.

Assessor lots for 409 and 499 Illinois St: DataSF Parcels (read 2026-10-11) shows lots 3940003, 3940004 and 3940005 added by a recording dated 2009-06-04, with the parcel geography added 2009-08-19. Lot 3940001, which the 2006 building permit used for 499 Illinois St, is retired (recorded drop date 2009-06-04, geography dropped 2009-08-19).

open_questions: This record combines two footprints that share one DataSF Building Footprints id (SF3940003): 499 Illinois St (south) and 409 Illinois St (north). It was formerly named '490/499 Illinois Street' and also carried UCSF's Valley Center for Vision at 490 Illinois St, which is the building across Illinois St on block 33 and now has its own record (corrected 2026-10-10).
Exact month/day of the 2008 completion of 499 Illinois St is not sourced, only the year.

The 2006 construction permit's own block/lot for 499 Illinois St (block 3940, lot 001) differs from the lots the Assessor now uses (lot 3940004, addressed 499 Illinois St, and lot 3940005, addressed 409 to 499 Illinois St). DataSF shows lot 3940001 as retired, with a recorded drop date of 2009-06-04, so the permit used a lot that has since been dropped; the address, biotechnical/medical-research-facility description, 6 stories, and $90M cost all line up with this parcel, so this is treated as the same building under a later lot number, not a different building. The permit's own completion sign-off (2009-04-06) also runs slightly later than the Assessor's 2008 year, which may reflect a lag between substantial completion and permit closeout.

2026-09-28: exact month/day for 409 Illinois St's 2026 renovation start, and the completion date within 2029, are not given by any source found: American School & University magazine (2026-09-08) says 'a completion date targeted for late 2029', while SF Standard (2025-12-17) says construction 'is expected to take about three years and be ready for occupants in the first quarter of 2029'. No project cost is shown because the one source is inconsistent with itself: Construction Dive (published September 1, 2026) says in its headline and text that the project "will cost approximately $278 million, per a prequalification notice on the project from the university", while the page's own project box lists "Value: $287 million". Neither is a contract amount, and the source does not say whether either covers construction alone or the whole project. No source read gives an SF Planning case number for this renovation; CEQAnet's notices list the University of California as the agency, and no source read says whether local planning review applies. DataSF Parcels, read 2026-10-11, lists three active lots on block 3940 with Illinois St addresses: lot 3940003 (409 Illinois St), lot 3940004 (499 Illinois St) and lot 3940005 (409 to 499 Illinois St), all with the same outline and all recorded as added on 2009-06-04. Lot 3940001, which the 2006 permit used, is retired. No source read says which lot the Assessor treats as 499 Illinois St's own or why three active lots share one outline.

No source read says who developed 499 Illinois St. SF Standard (2025-12-17) says UCSF's clinics, labs and offices leased space at 499 Illinois 'for more than a decade' and occupied 90% of the building before buying it.

Size of 409 and 499 Illinois St: 499 Illinois St has six stories per its 2006 DBI permit (its structural engineer, SGH, describes two five-story buildings over two levels of parking). SGH describes a 500,000 sq ft center in two buildings; SF Standard (2025) says 409 and 499 together add up to 470,000 sq ft; UC's own December 2025 acquisition filing gives about 525,421 rentable sq ft for 409 and 499 combined, on 3.6 acres with a 587-space shared garage. 409 Illinois St's renovation into the School of Dentistry / Interprofessional Education Center is 261,117 gross sq ft.
